ticket.description: The bookmark list can be sorted by the date a bookmark was added or by title. Add sorting by the date a bookmark was last modified, ascending and descending. The option is available wherever the existing sort options are: the sort dropdown of the bookmark list and the `sort` query parameter of the bookmarks REST API (`GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_asc` and `sort=modified_desc`), including the archived bookmarks list.
contract: GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_asc and sort=modified_desc; the same values on /api/bookmarks/archived/
Sort dropdown options labelled 'Modified ↑' (oldest modified first) and 'Modified ↓' (newest first), on the bookmark list and the archived list
An unknown sort value falls back to the default order, added newest first, with HTTP 200
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_asc returns the user's bookmarks ordered by date_modified ascending
GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_desc returns them ordered by date_modified descending
The bookmark list page offers 'Modified ↑' and 'Modified ↓' in the sort dropdown and selecting one reorders the list accordingly
The archived bookmarks list and its API accept the same two sort values
An unknown sort value still falls back to the default order (added, newest first)
